name: mirage
text: Status: the tennis fix is on main (the live lane now always reads ATP/WTA when live tennis is on), but the engine can't start on it yet. It stopped at 6:35 UTC for the restart and it's now past 3am ET, outside its 8am to 1am ET hours. I tried a start and the gate refused it. Changing the engine hours is on your list, so I won't touch it. Two options: press Run in the app and the engine starts on the new code right away, or it starts by itself at 8am ET with the fix. Either way, the lane status line will then show how many tennis games the feed has, how many Novig matched, and how many lines are priced. I'll check it as soon as it's up. The Tennis section for the Live tab and the multi-feed lane (CH58c/d) are next in the build.
